source: Pinned public Standard Ebooks passages, English 6.6; reviewed scope 2026-10-16
rebaselineReasons: Echo window is capped at 30 words; ambiguous or comparative readings cannot supply cross-form joins, and quote-to-quote pairs across paragraphs are suppressed. The scoped near range is now 12–25 regex words; tokenizer clitics can still put pairs outside 30. Precision remains 1.0; ordinary ladies/miss have positive regression fixtures.

Echo dev recall 43/58 and test 48/61 replace the previous broader morphology/window contract. Natural-copy recall is 25/26 in both splits; the suppressed copies are arched in dev and toasted in test, across quoted turns.

Repeated phrases now score three-use and two-near injections, including I got up and Piglet said that, at 100% recall. Distant twice-used pairs have separate negative controls rather than lowering recall; punctuation boundaries are tested in Rust.
